newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins 350 mln DM mobile phone order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins 350 mln DM mobile phone order.

text.p: German industrial giant Siemens AG said on Monday it won an order to deliver 350 million marks worth of mobile phone equipment to Taiwan.
The customer, Pacific Communications Services, planned to build a nationwide mobile phone network over the next two years, Siemens said.
The order called for Siemens to build 1,200 base and relay stations for a network based on the GSM digital standard.
The first part of the turnkey system was scheduled to begin operations in about six months and would eventually serve about one million customers, Siemens said.
PCS is a consortium led by Pacific Electric Wire and Cable Corp and Evergreen Marine Corp of Taiwan, and GTE Corp of the United States.
The group recenlty won the first license for providing nationwide mobile phone service. Taiwan began opening its phone market to competition last year.
